title: ToolAuditEvent
description: One line of .omao/audit/tool-events.jsonl. A lightweight, tool-level audit record written by the agenticops PostToolUse hook (audit-posttooluse.sh) after every tool call. Distinct from event.schema.json, which records semantic ontology decisions (approve/deploy/gate-pass) against the 8 ontology entities. This record is self-contained (no $ref) so the hook can emit conforming lines with only jq or python3 at runtime — no jsonschema dependency inside the installed plugin.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the hook recorded the event (post tool execution).

tool.description: Claude Code tool name (e.g. Bash, Write, Edit, Read).

classification.description: Whether the call was recognized as state-mutating. `mutating` calls also get an additionalContext feedback nudge; `benign` calls are recorded only.

matched_rule.description: Id of the mutating-pattern rule that classified this call, when classification=mutating.

command_excerpt.description: First bytes of the Bash command (truncated). Recorded for Bash calls; may be omitted for other tools.

session_id.description: Claude Code session id from the hook payload, when present.

cwd.description: Working directory reported by the hook payload, when present.

feedback_emitted.description: True when the hook returned an additionalContext nudge for this call.
